verdict.rationale: Mastra is an agent framework, so runtime tool discovery through meta-tools is a fair question for this kind of product. However, no evidence item describes search-and-load meta-tools or deferred tool definitions. The nearest items cover background MCP tasks, building MCP servers and tool-call tracing, which are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can search and load tools at runtime through meta-tools instead of having thousands of tool definitions stuffed into my context
